title: Filter Non-Gold Versions
description:
A build pipeline writes version strings to a log table. The team only cares about releases tagged either `vX.Y.Z` (SemVer-style, three dot-separated numbers) or `gold` (no trailing number).

Report every build whose `version` is **not** one of those two canonical forms. Use `REGEXP_LIKE(version, ...)` with alternation `|`. Name the columns `id` and `version`. Return rows in any order.
hint: Anchored alternatives `(^...$)|(^...$)` match either whole pattern. Wrap the test in NOT to keep only rows that match neither.
outputExplanation: 1.2.3 and gold match one of the two patterns and are dropped. 'gold.1' is not exactly 'gold', 'v1.2.3' has a leading v, and '1.2' has only two numbers, so all three fail both patterns and are kept.
